question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.4.
solution:
The correct answer is **Amidst**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given options the correct option to fill in the blank is **Amidst**. 
 
• In the given sentence, Amidst is used as a preposition. Amidst means 'in the middle of.'

The correct sentence is: **A****midst all this, I managed to find shelter. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A preposition is a word or phrase which is used to indicate time, place, direction, etc., and used before a noun or pronoun. 
 
• **Through **is used to describe something's or someone's movement from one side to the other. 
 
• **Within **is used to describe a distance less than a certain distance from something or a destination.
 
• **Along **is used when an object or someone is moving on or next to a line.
